raw_signal_observation: Bulk selection keeps selectedTaskIds separately from availableTaskIds. setAvailableTasks replaces the available list without pruning selectedTaskIds; collapsing list sections changes availableTaskIds, while bulk operations act on selectedTaskIds.
material_claim: A task can remain selected after it becomes hidden by a section-collapse/visibility change, so a later bulk action may include a task that is no longer visible.
neta_next_move: Run an integrated store/view test: select a task, change availableTaskIds via section collapse or equivalent visibility update, then assert whether selectedTaskIds is pruned and whether the bulk-action payload still contains the hidden task.
reversal_condition: If the integrated path prunes or clears hidden selections before bulk actions, the mechanism is refuted. If product intent explicitly requires persistent hidden selections, do not convert the behavior into a defect without OWNER authority.
baseline_decision: BUILD: prune selectedTaskIds when availableTaskIds changes, or clear bulk selection on section/filter visibility changes to prevent hidden-item bulk edits.
